COMMISSION MEETINGS SHALL GENERALLY BE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC
REMOTELY. The general public may attend the meeting in the Council Chambers
however must adhere to social distancing requirements. The public is encouraged to
watch and participate from the safety of their homes while practicing social distancing.

Council Chambers are open to a maximum 30 members of the general public. Once the
Council Chambers reach maximum occupancy, the general public may participate in
Oral Communication and address the City Council on an agenda item in person by

waiting in the City Hall Court Yard and entering the Chambers one at a time at the
appropriate time. No one will be admitted into the Council Chambers who is ill or
exhibiting symptoms of COVID-
  19.  Additionally, the general public may participate in
Oral Communication and address the City Council on an agenda items by providing
comments via Zoom or by sending comments to ask@cityofavalon.
